relationships.note: Every event belongs to one customer
Offer events only; transactions have no offer
Bridge: a channel filter must reach the offers and then the events

calculated_tables_extra_note: FunnelSteps is a disconnected table: it only supplies the four step names for the funnel chart (decision D4a: purchases forced in as step 4).

calculated_columns.name: First Completion Hour
calculated_columns.note: Hour of the customer's first completed offer; blank if never completed

calculated_columns.name: Offer Completion Group
dax: IF(DimCustomer[Completed Any Offer], "Completed at least one offer", "Never completed an offer")
calculated_columns.note: Series names for the Transaction Behavior charts

Q-05: not shown as its own field; only appears baked into the Offer Label text.

segments.note: Band edges and tier thresholds are proposals awaiting the customer's approval (story G-01, G-02). Sizes: age 876 to 3,421 per band; income 1,093 to 4,666; unknown age and income 2,175.

measures.name: Total Customers
measures.description: Customers in the current selection (respects demographic slicers).

measures.name: Offers Sent
measures.description: Number of 'offer received' events. One customer can receive the same offer more than once.

measures.name: Offers Viewed
measures.description: Number of 'offer viewed' events.

measures.name: Offers Completed
measures.description: Number of 'offer completed' events. Repeated rows are kept (decision D3); see Repeated Completion Rows.

measures.name: Redeemable Offers Sent
measures.description: Offers sent, excluding informational offers, which cannot be completed. Denominator of the redemption rate (decision D2).

measures.name: Repeated Completion Rows
measures.description: Completed rows that repeat an earlier identical row (same customer, offer and hour). Shown for transparency; they are included in Offers Completed.
dax: CALCULATE(COUNTROWS(FactEvents), FactEvents[Event] = "offer completed", FactEvents[Is Repeated Row] = TRUE())

measures.name: Customers Who Completed
measures.description: Customers with at least one completed offer.

measures.name: View Rate
measures.description: Offers viewed divided by offers sent.

measures.name: Redemption Rate
measures.description: Offers completed divided by offers sent, excluding informational offers (decision D2). Channel breakdowns overlap: the data lists channels per offer, not per event, so an offer's events count under every channel it uses.
dax: DIVIDE(CALCULATE([Offers Completed], DimOffer[Is Informational] = FALSE()) + 0, [Redeemable Offers Sent])

measures.name: Transactions
measures.description: Number of purchase transactions. Transactions carry no offer, so an offer or channel filter removes them; use Funnel Transactions for the funnel.

measures.name: Total Spend
measures.description: Sum of transaction amounts in US dollars.

measures.name: Average Transaction Amount
measures.description: Total spend divided by the number of transactions.

measures.name: Customers Who Transacted
measures.description: Customers with at least one transaction.

measures.name: Transactions per Customer
measures.description: Transactions divided by customers who transacted.

measures.name: Rewards Paid
measures.description: Sum of rewards on completed offers, in US dollars.

measures.name: Funnel Sent
measures.description: Funnel step 1: offers received.

measures.name: Funnel Viewed
measures.description: Funnel step 2: offers viewed.

measures.name: Funnel Completed
measures.description: Funnel step 3: offers completed.

measures.name: Funnel Value
measures.description: Value for each step of the offer funnel chart: offers received, viewed, completed and purchases by an engaged customer (decision D4a, confirmed: forced into the funnel as a 4th step). Use with the FunnelSteps table.

measures.name: Funnel Transactions
measures.description: Funnel step 4 (decision D4, D4a): transactions made by customers who viewed or completed the selected offers. Not time-ordered, and larger than step 1 because one customer can buy many times, so the bar is wider than 'offers received'. Offer filters are removed from the transactions themselves because transactions carry no offer.
dax: CALCULATETABLE(VALUES(FactEvents[Customer ID]), FactEvents[Event] IN {"offer viewed", "offer completed"})
CALCULATE([Transactions], REMOVEFILTERS(DimOffer), REMOVEFILTERS(OfferChannel), TREATAS(Engaged, FactEvents[Customer ID]))

measures.name: Transactions Before First Completion
measures.description: Transactions made before the customer's first completed offer. Customers who never completed an offer are excluded. The transaction at the completion hour is excluded because it triggered the completion.
dax: RETURN IF(NOT ISBLANK(fc) && FactEvents[Hours Since Start] < fc, 1, 0)

measures.name: Transactions After First Completion
measures.description: Transactions made after the customer's first completed offer (strictly later hour).
dax: RETURN IF(NOT ISBLANK(fc) && FactEvents[Hours Since Start] > fc, 1, 0)

measures.name: Spend Before First Completion
measures.description: Total spend before the customer's first completed offer.
dax: RETURN IF(NOT ISBLANK(fc) && FactEvents[Hours Since Start] < fc, FactEvents[Amount], 0)

measures.name: Spend After First Completion
measures.description: Total spend after the customer's first completed offer.
dax: RETURN IF(NOT ISBLANK(fc) && FactEvents[Hours Since Start] > fc, FactEvents[Amount], 0)

measures.name: Average Amount Before Completion
measures.description: Average transaction amount before the first completed offer.
dax: DIVIDE([Spend Before First Completion], [Transactions Before First Completion])

measures.name: Average Amount After Completion
measures.description: Average transaction amount after the first completed offer.
dax: DIVIDE([Spend After First Completion], [Transactions After First Completion])

measures.name: Minimum Spend of Selected Offers
measures.description: Average minimum purchase needed to unlock the selected offers (the offer's difficulty). Used on the difficulty against completion chart.

measures.name: Daily Transactions per Customer
measures.description: Transactions divided by the customers in the current group. By observation day this is the average number of purchases per customer that day.

measures.name: Share of Customers
measures.description: Customers in the current group as a share of all customers.

measures.name: Redemption Rate vs All Customers
measures.description: Redemption rate of the current group minus the redemption rate of all customers, in percentage points.
